name: Tanaka Kanata
source:
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Kanata is the Student council's secretary. She was elected to this position as a joke, thanks to her name, which is easy to remember. Her main job is to take handwritten notes of every convention they're having on the student's council. Even though Tanaka-san gained this position not because of respect, she takes her job very seriously. She even practices her writing every night at home. She has gained an obsession to writing fonts due to this, but it seem that her favourite font is Mincho.
